'''June 2000 Framingham tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Framingham, MA on 3 June 2000. [[Steve Brentson]] won it. It is known from Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d845">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-06-framingham-ma-6-3-2000d845/ framingham-ma-6-3-2000], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 6 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-06-framingham-ma-6-3-2000d845/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Framingham, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
